subject: general
question:
Read the statements given below and select the correct option.

Statement I: Zinc displaces copper from copper sulphate solution, but copper cannot displace zinc from zinc sulphate solution.

Statement II: Zinc is more reactive than copper in the reactivity series.

options.text: Both statements are correct, and Statement II correctly explains Statement I.
Both statements are correct, but Statement II does not explain Statement I.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both statements are correct, and Statement II correctly explains Statement I.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement I:** Zinc displaces copper from copper sulphate solution, but copper cannot displace zinc from zinc sulphate solution.

 
 
• This statement is **correct**.
 
• When zinc is added to copper sulphate solution, it reacts to form zinc sulphate and copper metal. This occurs because zinc is more reactive than copper.
 
• However, when copper is added to zinc sulphate solution, no reaction occurs as copper cannot displace zinc due to its lower reactivity.
 
 
 
• **Statement II:** Zinc is more reactive than copper in the reactivity series.
 
 
• This statement is also **correct**.
 
• The reactivity series is a list of metals arranged in order of their reactivity. Zinc is positioned above copper, indicating that it is more reactive.
 
• The higher reactivity of zinc allows it to displace copper from its compounds in aqueous solutions.
